_note: The mind (GDD 4.9.4; session M1, read by MindSystem, scripts/core/mind_system.gd). Three moods, each a hidden value 0-100 shown as a word: confidence and motivation have the middle word OK (`middle` = [low, high], both included), stress the bottom word Calm. NEWS moves a mood at once (`news`: a PB, a last place, an injury, a goal met, a moment's answer; numbers are points on the 0-100 scale). Every SUNDAY NIGHT each mood drifts `rate` of the way to its target (`drift`): the target is `base` plus the pulls of your situation (fit with the coach, trust, monotony, a long layoff, stress, the mental plan...). EFFECTS (user 2026-10-17: the GDD sizes with a calm middle): nothing changes while confidence and motivation are in their middle word, so the neutral game is exactly the old one. Motivation sets the quality of training (every session's training effect x quality: `effects.motivation` at 0 and 100, 1.0 across the middle, straight lines between); confidence a race-day term (a share of race time, + = faster) at its ends (`effects.confidence`), times the meet level's `level_scale`; stress has no effect of its own: it pulls motivation down (drift.motivation.stress). Mental attributes that grow (`growth`): consistency from every race (more when the race is different from the last one: Hopkins & Hewson 2001), composure from big meets (national / international), each times a headroom (20 - value) / headroom_span (between headroom_min and 1); composure also from the weekly mental plan (`mental_plan`, at best about +0.5 a year: the 2023 meta-analysis). Ambition (hidden): how much a goal level above or below the coach's pick moves motivation, and the 'held back' pull on a Steady plan. All UI and coach texts are here too.

effects._note: motivation: training quality at value 0 and 100 (1.0 across the middle). confidence: race-day share of time at value 0 and 100 (0 across the middle), times level_scale of the meet's level.

news._note: Points added at once. Race news (the evening of the race day, from the last round run and the meet's best time): pb, sb (not a PB), well_below (slower than the season best going in by more than well_below_pct; else below by more than below_pct: below), win, last (field of at least last_min_field), dnf, dq, beat_above = each runner who went in with a faster season best (else personal best) than yours and finished behind you, up to beat_above_max. motivation_pb: motivation for a PB. Injury news by tier at the diagnosis (confidence, stress). Goals: met (confidence, motivation), missed (confidence, each missed goal at the season's review or a missed place), set (motivation, the novelty of new goals) + per level above / below the coach's pick: ambition_step x (ambition / 10). New phase: motivation (novelty; season-plan careers). Moments: a reply's confidence / motivation / stress points x moment_point; from the coach also x his lift (1 + (motivating - 10) x coaching.json effects.motivating.lift_per_point) x the trust factor.

big_meet._note: Sunday night before a week with a big meet (big_levels): stress + stress x (1 - (composure - 10) x composure_per_point), x relaxation_share with relaxation training in the mental plan. The next Sunday's drift takes it back down.

drift._note: Sunday night: value += (target - value) x rate. confidence: base 50, an active injury (tier injury / serious) pulls it down; rate is faster while below the target with a good mental coach: x (1 + (mental_coaching - 10) x back_per_point). motivation: base 50 + the coach's fit (click / friction), his style (per step: + supportive, - controlling, but not for the temperaments in coaching.json fit.no_controlling_penalty), trust, his Motivating ((motivating - 10) x motivating_per_point), monotony (the same repeating week or season phase for more than monotony.grace weeks: per_week each week after, at most `max`), a layoff (no running for layoff_days or more), stress (above stress_from: per point), held back (a Steady plan with ambition above held_back.ambition_above: per point of ambition above it). stress: base 20 + an active injury, a strained coach, a week far above your normal load (load vs normal above load_from %: per point, at most load_max), relaxation training in the mental plan. (A big meet in the coming week is news: news.big_meet.)

growth._note: Mental attributes that grow outside training (training sessions and races already grow them through their effects in training.json / competitions.json). Applied on the evening of a race day. consistency: per_race x headroom, x varied when the meet's level or indoor/outdoor differs from the last race's. composure: per_big_race (national / international meets) x headroom x the coach's mental coaching (coaching.json effects.mental_coaching.composure_per_point) x the confidence factor (1 + (confidence - 50) / 50 x confidence_share).

mental_plan._note: The weekly mental plan (GDD 4.9.4; Training tab): none, one, two or all three kinds, one short session of each a week (so 0-3 sessions). Sunday night each session grows composure by `composure` x headroom x the coach's mental coaching (imagery x target_week when a target is in the coming week); relaxation lowers the stress target (drift.stress.relaxation); self-talk lifts the confidence target by `confidence`. All three at a composure of 10: about +0.5 a year (the 2023 meta-analysis: moderate effects at best). No body strain. The cue word (self-talk) is shown on the race cards. Life load (school) comes with S1.

imagery.name: Imagery
imagery.text: Picture the race before it happens: the start, the bell, the kick. Strongest the week before a target.

relaxation.name: Relaxation and breathing
relaxation.text: Slow breathing and letting go of tension. Lowers stress a little.

self_talk.name: Self-talk
self_talk.text: What you say to yourself when it hurts, with a cue word you pick. Your word shows on the race cards.

causes._note: The lines of the recent causes (tap a mood row). {meet} {who} {goal} {injury} are filled in.
causes.beat_above: Beat runners ranked above you at {meet}

pulls._note: The ongoing pulls shown under a mood (what the Sunday drift heads for). {coach} = his first name, {weeks}.
pulls.held_back: You want more than a Steady plan
pulls.parent_coach: Your coach is also your parent: training comes home with you

ui.head: MIND
ui.hint: Tap a mood to see why it is where it is.
ui.no_pulls: Nothing in particular: it settles back towards the middle.
ui.ambition_high: You dream big: big goals lift you more, being held back hurts more.
ui.ambition_low: You're content: goals and plans move you less either way.
ui.race_faster: You race a little faster at a meet like this.
ui.race_slower: You race a little slower at a meet like this.
ui.plan_text: Short sessions without body strain. Small on purpose: over a year they make you a little calmer under pressure.

confidence.low: Low confidence costs you a little time on race day, most at big meets.
confidence.high: High confidence gives you a little time on race day, most at big meets.
confidence.middle: No effect on your races now.

motivation.low: Low motivation: your sessions train you less than they could.
motivation.high: High motivation: your sessions train you a bit more.
motivation.middle: Your sessions train you as normal.

helps_text.confidence: Good races (PBs, beating runners ranked above you), goals met and a coach whose praise lands. A good mental coach brings it back faster after a bad race. Self-talk helps a little.
helps_text.motivation: A coach you click with, new things (a new phase, new goals), variety in your training and staying healthy. The same week for months wears it down, and so does stress.
helps_text.stress: Relaxation training, a normal training load and time. School adds to it: tests, heavy study effort, late nights and double days on school days; holidays ease it.

coach._note: The Sunday talk's mood line (CoachTalk detail normal or full; a coach with communication <= 7 skips it): the mood furthest out of its middle (or moved at least moved_min this week) picks a line: <mood>_<low|high>. {first} = the athlete's first name.

calm.confidence_low: I can see the last results have knocked you. They don't define you.
calm.confidence_high: You're believing in yourself. Good. Keep it quiet and keep working.
calm.motivation_low: You look a bit flat lately. That happens, and it passes.
calm.motivation_high: You've been keen this week. I like that.
calm.stress_high: You seem tense. Let's keep things simple this week.

drill.confidence_high: Confident is good. Cocky isn't. Stay hungry.
drill.motivation_low: You've been dragging your feet. Wake up.
drill.motivation_high: That's the fire I want to see.
drill.stress_high: You're wound up. Breathe, then work.

warm.confidence_low: Hey, {first}. A bad patch is not who you are. I'm proud of you anyway.
warm.confidence_high: You're glowing lately, {first}. Enjoy it, you earned it.
warm.motivation_low: You seem a bit low, {first}. Want to talk about it?
warm.motivation_high: It's lovely to see you this keen.
warm.stress_high: You seem stressed, {first}. Look after yourself first.

tactician.confidence_low: Your belief has dropped more than your form has. The numbers say you're fine.
tactician.confidence_high: Confidence is up. Use it in the races that matter.
tactician.motivation_low: Your sessions have lost some edge. Let's find out why.
tactician.motivation_high: Good intent in training this week. It shows in the splits.
tactician.stress_high: Stress is up. We'll keep the week predictable.

analyst.confidence_low: Your confidence dropped more than your numbers did. Look at the tests: you're on track.
analyst.confidence_high: Confidence is up, and the data backs it.
analyst.motivation_low: Your session quality dipped this week. Something's off, and we'll find it.
analyst.motivation_high: Session quality was high this week. Good.
analyst.stress_high: Your stress is up. I'll keep the plan simple and predictable.

mentor.confidence_low: A bad patch passes. It always does.
mentor.confidence_high: You believe in yourself. Good. Stay humble with it.
mentor.motivation_low: You look tired of it. That happens to everyone. It comes back.
mentor.stress_high: Too much on your plate. Let's keep training simple.

motivator.confidence_low: Hey {first}! I believe in you, even when you don't. Remember that!
motivator.confidence_high: Look at you, {first}! Confident and flying!
motivator.motivation_low: You've lost a bit of spark, {first}. Let's find it again together!
motivator.motivation_high: Love this energy, {first}! Keep it coming!
motivator.stress_high: You're carrying a lot, {first}. Breathe. We'll keep training fun this week.

speed.confidence_low: Your legs are faster than your head thinks right now.
speed.motivation_low: You look flat. Flat legs, flat head. Let's do something fast and fun.
speed.stress_high: Stressed legs are slow legs. Short sessions this week.
